description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 Score (%) for two models: “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information,” as presented in the paper “Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization.” The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” spans a linear scale from approximately 0.5 to 1.5, with tick marks at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58, with major ticks every 2 percentage points. The “MATTER (ours)” model is represented by a pink line with circular markers and a solid line style, accompanied by a semi-transparent pink shaded region indicating uncertainty or variance. This line begins at approximately 55.1% at 0.6 tokens, dips slightly to 54.4% at 0.7, rises to a peak of 57.8% at 1.0 tokens, then declines to 51.0% at 1.5 tokens. The “w/o material information” model is shown as a purple line with circular markers and a solid line, with a corresponding light purple shaded region. It starts at 52.4% at 0.6 tokens, peaks at 54.2% at 0.7 tokens, then gradually declines to 51.8% at 1.2, dips to 51.7% at 1.3, rises slightly to 53.4% at 1.4, and then sharply drops to 47.6% at 1.5 tokens. Both lines exhibit variability across the token range, with the shaded areas reflecting the spread of scores around the mean trend.
